div.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; height: 100%;

table.style: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;

th.style: padding: 12px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; font-size: 15px; border-bottom: 2px solid #1d4ed8; letter-spacing: 0.5px;

tr.style: background-color: #f1f5f9; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 2px solid #cbd5e1; font-size: 12px;
